title: M4 – Adaptive Learning Loop
description: Scope: DSPy compiles (>1k labeled traces), online eval harness, self-tuning thresholds + rollback paths.\nExit: Rank/Summarize/Redact outperform baselines by ≥10%, automated retraining + deployment pipeline in place.

title: M1 – Budget-aware Selection
description: Scope: Deferred query planner, EV gate, knapsack+MMR selector, slot composer, manual transport handoff.\nExit: Demonstrate efficacy lift on 3 replays with budget ledgers + redundancy metrics per patch.

title: M1.T1 – Deferred query planner
description: Design+implement deferred query planner service: generate deferred_query candidates w/ expected value + cost, execute Stage A picking subset under latency/tokens budgets, persist results.

title: M1.T2 – Budget-led knapsack selector
description: Rewrite selector into two-stage knapsack+MMR using explicit budget ledger (tokens/latency/dollars/risk). Includes cooling logic, redundancy penalties, explanation traces, and tests.

title: M1.T3 – Slot composer & ledger outputs
description: Enhance slot composer: map Stage B selections into slot blueprints with redundancy-aware compression and citations; ensure ledger outputs accompany manual+auto patches.

title: M1.T4 – Selection evaluation harness
description: Build evaluation harness + dataset replay for Stage A/B selection, capturing efficacy-per-token, redundancy, and ledger accuracy; integrate into pytest or standalone CLI.

title: M3 – Temporal Graph & Skills
description: Scope: Temporal graph bitemporal store, consolidation jobs, consented skill promotion + cohort sharing, graph-powered retrieval covering ≥30% context.\nExit: Skill promotions tracked w/ win rate >55%, graph queries part of prod selection traces.

title: M0 – Traceable Observe
description: Scope: Tap connectors, observer v2, novelty filters, manual CPP export.\nExit: ≥2 provider streams ingested, schema-complete candidates with provenance, reviewer dashboard with ledgers.

title: M0.T1 – Build session tap & proxy connectors
description: Ship provider-agnostic tap SDK + proxy stubs for chat/tool/IDE feeds. Deliver ingest adapters for OpenAI Realtime + CLI replay. Provide contract tests + sample configs.

title: M0.T2 – Implement observer v2 with novelty filters
description: Design observer v2 with DSPy + heuristics fallback, novelty scoring, and schema validation. Includes tests + instrumentation.

title: M0.T3 – Reviewer dashboard & manual CPP export
description: Build reviewer UI/CLI to inspect candidates, provenance, and ledgers; allow manual CPP export for injection. Includes audit logging + docs.

title: M2 – Proactive CPP Injection & Governance
description: Scope: Transport broker (OpenAI first), governance service w/ policy packs + redactor, automated CPP injection under 600 ms p95.\nExit: Closed-loop observe→inject canary passes latency SLA, zero leakage in red-team suite.

title: M2.T1 – Transport broker & injections
description: Implement transport broker that routes CPP patches to OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini, handles retries/circuit breakers, and surfaces transport acks in API.

title: M2.T2 – Governance policies & redaction
description: Implement policy packs + redaction enforcement: scoped budgets, consent registry hooks, risk cooling, and  persistence.

title: M2.T3 – Consent registry & audit logging
description: Implement consent registry + immutable audit log: scope approvals, per-tenant policies,  persistence to storage, and CLI viewer.

title: M2.T4 – Transport health & chaos tests
description: Add transport health monitoring, circuit breakers, and integration tests (simulated provider endpoints + retries) to guarantee proactive injections stay within SLA.
